ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a spiderweb-like line-segment diagram. Near the center, a smaller upper triangle can be seen, whose three sides are labeled x, 9, and 5; the lower triangle beside it has three sides labeled x, 5, and 17. Peripheral labels such as 10, 18, 16, and 28 are also visible in the figure, but according to what the problem requires, these peripheral lengths do not need to be used. Reasoning: For the upper triangle, the three sides are x, 9, and 5, and they must satisfy the triangle inequality: |9-5| < x < 9+5, so 4 < x < 14. For the lower triangle, the three sides are x, 5, and 17, and they must satisfy: |17-5| < x < 17+5, so 12 < x < 22. The intersection of the two is 12 < x < 14. Because x is an integer, the only possible value is x = 13.
